headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal, Khaitan & Co act on JSW One ₹3,054 crore proposed IPO
sum: JSW One Platforms Limited has filed a draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering of equity shares aggregating up to ₹3,054.01 crore ($318.62 million), comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale by certain existing…
detail: JSW One Platforms Limited has filed a draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering of equity shares aggregating up to ₹3,054.01 crore ($318.62 million), comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale by certain existing shareholders. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is advising JSW One on this IPO. The transaction team includes Yash J. Ashar (Senior Partner), Manan Lahoty (Partner – Head Capital Markets), Devaki Mankad (Partner, Regional Co-Head - Capital Markets - West), Tanushri More (Principal Associate), Rishav Buxi (Principal Associate), Adwait Deshmukh (Senior Associate), Urmil Shah (Senior Associate), Associates Anomitra Debnath, Nikshetaa Jain, Rishika Saraswat, Mitali…
